scenes.caption: Rain hits granite and starts downhill
scenes.narration: A drop of rain lands on rough granite. Gravity pulls it over tiny grooves, collecting other runoff as it speeds toward lower ground.

scenes.caption: Streams carve rock and pick up minerals
scenes.narration: The flowing water threads through a mountain stream. It dissolves minerals from exposed rock, carrying them along as clear water turns faintly mineral-rich.

scenes.caption: A widening river carries the load
scenes.narration: The stream gathers more water and widens into a river. Minerals dissolved in the runoff travel downstream, staying mixed with the flowing water.

scenes.caption: Evaporation returns water, not salt
scenes.narration: At the ocean, sunlight heats the surface. Water evaporates as vapour, leaving dissolved salts behind as seawater becomes more concentrated over time.

scenes.caption: Salt crystals form as dusk falls
scenes.narration: As evening cools the shore, water held near the sand dries. Salt crystallizes at the edge of the sea, and the cycle repeats with every new sky-returned drop.
